# pve_sdn_subnet (Resource)

SDN subnet (IP range with optional DHCP/gateway/SNAT) inside a VNet; the resource id includes the VNet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_subnet" "example" {
  subnet = "CHANGE_ME"
  vnet   = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subnet` (String) Subnet in CIDR notation (e.g. `10.0.0.0/24`).
- `vnet` (String) associated vnet

### Optional

- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `dhcp_dns_server` (String) IP address for the DNS server
- `dhcp_range` (List of String) A list of DHCP ranges for this subnet
- `dnszoneprefix` (String) dns domain zone prefix  ex: 'adm' -> <hostname>.adm.mydomain.com
- `gateway` (String) Subnet Gateway: Will be assign on vnet for layer3 zones
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `snat` (Boolean) enable masquerade for this subnet if pve-firewall

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: vnet/subnet (also the `terraform import` format).
- `subnet_id` (String) PVE's internal subnet identifier (`<zone>-<ip>-<prefix>`), used in item API paths.
